RAJASTHAN RAJYA VIDYUT PRASARAN NIGAM LIMITED
OFFICE OF THE ZONAL CHIEF ENGINEER (T&C-JPZ), JAIPUR
NOTIFICATION
Jaipur, February 11, 2026

Rajkaj Ref No. 20464685:-In pursuance to the notification Dt. 03.10.2017& 05.11.2024
issued by the Energy Department, Govt. of Rajasthan, Jaipur which was published in the
Rajasthan Gazette dated 09.10.2017& 08.11.2024 under the Sec.164 and 67 & 68 of the
Electricity Act, 2003 respectively as well as the power of the Telegraph Authority under the
provision of the Indian Telegraph Act , 1885 (Central Act 13 of 1885) to the Zonal Chief
Engineer (T&C), Jaipur of Rajasthan Rajya Vidyut Prasaran Nigam Ltd. (the state
Transmission utility ) to erect electric lines/ electric plants for the transmission of electricity
or for the purpose of telephonic of telegraphic communications necessary for the proper
coordination works. Hence the undersigned to exercise of the above powers, here by accord
the sanction of right of way for “Construction work of 220 KV D/C JAWALI-KUMHER
(400 KV GSS) LINE FOR 220 KV GSS JAWALI ” for the supply of electricity. The said
line will pass within the boundary / revenue area of following villages/places and Location
Coordinates: -
